If your working directory is myfolder/homework/, what relative path would you specify to get the file located at myfolder/MyData.csv?
../MyData.csv



What are the major benefits of using R projects?
R projects provide a way to divide your work. Each with their own:
Working directory Workspace (environment with stored data/objects) History Folder structure & source documents
It is very easy to connect with GitHub for version control and collaboration.



What is Git and what is GitHub?
Git is a version control system. GitHub is a hosting service that provides a home for our Git based projects.



What are the two main differences between a tibble and a data.frame?
Tibbles print cleaner and usual return a tibble when you subset them. This makes them easier to chain.
Data frames try to print everything by default, but usually try to print out a vector, making them not print results as cleanly. Also, not easily chain-able.



Rewrite the following nested function call using baseR’s chaining operator:
library(tidyverse)
arrange(filter(select(as_tibble(iris), starts_with("Petal"), Species), Petal.Length < 1.55), Species)
Answer:
as_tibble(iris) |>
  select(starts_with("Petal"), Species) |>
  filter(Petal.Length < 1.55) |>
  arrange(Species)



What is meant by long format data and wide format data? Which do we generally prefer for statistical analysis?
Long format - Each row is a single observation Wide format - Each row is a subject, different columns are different observations
For statistical analysis, we perfer long form as it is much easier to work with for modeling and is more flexible. It is also easier to group and summarize.

What are the major benefits of using R Projects?
Answer:

Automatically sets the working directory.
Keeps project files organized.
Makes relative paths easier to use.
Improves reproducibility and collaboration.

What is Git and what is GitHub?
Answer:

Git is a version control system used to track changes to files and code.
GitHub is a cloud platform that hosts Git repositories and enables collaboration.

Tibbles print only a preview of the data instead of the entire object.

What is meant by long format data and wide format data? Which do we generally prefer for statistical analysis?
Answer:

Long format: Each row consists of one observation and each column one variable.
Wide format: More than one observation may exist in a given row.

Wide format data is often used in pivot tables and can be easier to display. However, long format data is generally preferred for statistical analysis because most plotting, summarizing, and modeling tools expect data to be in long form.

If your working directory is myfolder/homework/, what relative path would you specify to get the file located at myfolder/MyData.csv?
read_csv("../MyData.csv")
What are the major benefits of using R projects?
R projects provide a self-contained working environment for R scripts, markdown documents, data, and outputs. R projects save the working state so that variables and command history are preserved when reopening. Additionally, R projects are portable and suitable for GitHub integration.
What is Git and what is GitHub?
Git is version control system for tracking changes and collaboration that allows for branching and merging. GitHub is website for hosting Git repositories with additional collaborative features.
What are the two main differences between a tibble and a data.frame?
When a single column of a data frame is selected, the result is a vector. When a single column of a tibble is selected, the result is still a tibble. Additionally, compared to data frames, tibbles print in a cleaner format by default.
Rewrite the following nested function call using base R’s chaining operator:


library(tidyverse)
arrange(filter(select(as_tibble(iris), starts_with("Petal"), Species), Petal.Length < 1.55), Species)


iris |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(starts_with("Petal"), Species) |>
  filter(Petal.Length < 1.55) |>
  arrange(Species)


What is meant by long format data and wide format data? Which do we generally prefer for statistical analysis?
The distinction between wide and long data formats is applicable when the data includes repeated observations for the same subject. In wide data format, the repeated observations are across multiple columns. In long data format, the repeated observations are across multiple rows. Long data format is preferred for statistical analysis.
